title: King and pawn: king in front
description: Win by getting your king to the sixth rank in front of the pawn, then promote.

title: King and pawn: take the opposition
description: Only one first move wins. Take the opposition and escort the pawn home.

title: King and pawn: hold the draw
description: Defend as Black. Keep your king in front of the pawn and take the opposition.

title: Lucena position
description: Push the king away, build a bridge on the fourth rank, and promote.

title: Philidor defence
description: Defend as Black: rook on your third rank, then checks from behind once the pawn advances.

title: Rook and two connected pawns
description: Use your king and rook to shepherd the connected pawns through.

title: Mate with king and queen
description: Box the king in with your queen, bring your own king, and mate on the edge. Watch out for stalemate.

title: Mate with king and rook
description: Cut the king off with the rook, use your king to take the opposition, and push it to the edge.
